placement.body: axis along the header row (world y), centred at y 3.81 between GAIN and Vin, 3.0 mm inboard of the row (world x 35.76, towards the terminal block) and 2.45 mm below the PCB (z 135.78)
placement.insulation: lateral offset: the heat-shrunk body runs beside the SD and GND tails, not under them; clear heat-shrink over the body; legs reach GAIN and Vin from outside the pair, so no bare lead passes SD or GND; Kapton over the two joints

sideFindingHeaderHeight.note: Outside the resistor scope. The audio study puts the header pin centreline 4.02 mm above the board (RA_PIN_Z); on Sullins 11637 0.158 in [4.02 mm] is the tail-to-insulator-front distance and the pin is drawn centred in the 2.54 mm insulator (about 1.27 mm high), as the bench end-view drawing also shows. hous_low = six housings at that lower height, 14 mm long from the insulator front face (Sullins-like header, inference).

verifiedFromPrimarySources: Board outline 17.78 x 19.05 mm; header JP1 pads on a line 2.54 mm from the header edge, pitch 2.54 mm, round pads diameter 1.9304 mm, drill 1.0 mm (adafruit-brd).

Header pad nets: pad 1 VDD (Vin), 2 GND, 3 SD_MODE, 4 GAIN, 5 DIN, 6 BCLK, 7 LRCLK; silkscreen LRC BCLK DIN GAIN SD GND Vin. In the robot frame GAIN is at y 0, SD 2.54, GND 5.08, Vin 7.62 (adafruit-brd + audio-study mapping).
Every SMD part is on the top copper layer; the underside carries only the header and terminal-block through-hole tails and the mounting-hole pads (adafruit-brd).
R1 (1 MOhm, VDD to SD_MODE, 0805) sits at brd (13.716, 5.334) = world x 35.97, y 4.83, directly behind the SD/GND pins on the top side; U1 at world x 33.68, y 0 (adafruit-brd).

YAGEO MFR-25 (normal size, the 1/4 W part in MFR-25FBF52-100K): L 6.3 +/- 0.5 mm, D 2.4 +/- 0.2 mm, lead 0.55 +/- 0.05 mm, lead length 28 +/- 2.0 mm; no minimum bend distance given; resistance-to-soldering-heat test immersed to 3 +/- 0.5 mm from the body; -55 to +155 C (yageo-mfr p3-p4). "52" = 52.4 mm tape spacing.

Sullins 11637 rev F, termination BA: tail 0.120 in (3.05 mm) from the insulator seating face, mating 0.230 in (5.84 mm), post 0.025 in (0.64 mm) square, insulator 2.54 mm high x 2.50 mm deep, tail centreline to insulator front face 0.158 in (4.02 mm) (sullins-11637; reference only).
fromStudyOrBenchFilesNotReverified: Board thickness 1.57 mm and the amp position (board x 22.25..41.3, y +/-8.89, top z 139.8): audio-study constants.

Resistor placement: body axis 3.0 mm inboard of the row and 2.45 mm below the PCB, heat-shrink 2.9 x 7.0 mm with 1.0 mm to the PCB, legs bent 1.3 mm from the body (nominal L), legs 0.67 mm outboard of each tail, hooks 0.9 mm below the PCB, stack about 4 mm: measured from the bench drawings (endview 34 px/mm, underside 30 px/mm).
inference: Tail length of the owner header: 1.5 mm nominal (bench README; Sullins-like 3.05 - 1.57 = 1.48 mm), 2.5 mm worst case (coordinator). Brand unknown.
Header top side for the top fallback: pin centre 1.27 mm above the board, vertical segment 0.64 mm square, insulator front 4.02 mm ahead of the tail (Sullins geometry applied to an unknown header).
SMD heights used: U1 0.8, R1 0.65, other 0805 parts 1.45 mm (conservative, unverified).
Solder: header fillet cone pad diameter 1.93 mm to 0.9 mm over 0.6 mm; hook joint with Kapton radius 1.2 mm down to the tail tip + 0.3 mm, pad-wide at the board.
Iron: generic fine conical tip (R0.5, cone to r 2.0 over 10 mm, r 2.0 to 20 mm, r 3.5 barrel to 80 mm).
